fields.Name: T115 - AI Prompt Detail
fields.Description: Verifies the AI Prompt detail view (resilient to the known prompt-loading issue).

InputDefinition.goal: In the AI app, open the Prompts section. If the prompts list is populated, click a prompt to open its detail view and verify prompt details/configuration are shown. NOTE: the prompts list may intermittently show 'Error loading prompts' / 'No prompts found' due to a known data-loading issue — if so, verifying that the Prompts section renders (without crashing) is acceptable. Success = a prompt's detail opened OR the Prompts section rendered with its current state; a crash is a fail. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The AI Prompts section is reachable and rendered
Either a prompt detail view opened OR the prompts list rendered (even if in the known empty/error state)
No crash, raw error stack, or blank white screen
